svg.title: §3 Systems in the field: FedCardio, ProtoFL-Sec, ProtoShield-FL, BiomarkHER2, NammadeVote.
svg.text: Five systems built to be used, from hospital wards to polling booths.

text.tspan: Federated ECG arrhythmia classification with Class-Sensitive Aggregation and Rényi DP under
Poisson subsampling. 98.7% accuracy at ε = 3.1 on MIT-BIH, checked against gradient-inversion
An attack testbed for prototype-based federated learning with reproducible leakage scoring:
prototype inversion, DLG with prototype alignment, and a hybrid attack that warm-starts from
Prototype-based federated learning combined with secure multi-party computation and
AI-assisted HER2 IHC scoring with FISH confirmation, built for Kerala’s government medical
colleges rather than for a benchmark. Alongside it, the HER2 IHC track of the LoFi/MedG
project at Dr. Xiaoxiao Li’s TEA Lab, UBC ECE: data pipeline, fine-tuning and bug reports on
the team’s training and evaluation code.
An AI election-intelligence platform with live polling-booth queues and voter assistance, built
for the Thiruvananthapuram District Administration; it drew statewide media coverage.
